lines.en: Okay. Ten blocks down. Five to go.
Oh, wait! Stop, stop, stop!
Oh, I'm sorry. Do you need a break?
My boots in tan!
Hey, can you get a little closer so I can see the price?
I can see it from right here.
It'll cost you one husband.
Okay, I'm sorry. I think I can walk the rest of the way now.
Just give me my boots.
I don't have your boots.
Well, I don't have them either. Where are they?
Well, why don't you check in one of my saddlebags
while I chew on a bale of hay?
Okay. Good. Well, we gotta go back and get them.
Honey, are you seriously ever gonna wear the boots again?
Okay, I'm never gonna wear them again.
I just didn't get a chance to say goodbye.
You know what? You can say goodbye to the tannerlings.
Okay. All right.
Okay.
Bye, boots.
Wait! Half off!
